recent_posts.title: What’s new in Windows Holographic, version 24H1
recent_posts.summary: Windows Holographic version 24H1 has been released, featuring highlights such as shared Microsoft Entra accounts, auto unlock policy, network connectivity report, and more.

recent_posts.title: Annotate from anywhere with Spatial Annotations in Microsoft Teams
recent_posts.summary: Frontline workers can now use the Spatial Annotations feature in the Teams mobile app for real-time collaboration and annotation in space. This eliminates the need for a separate app and provides a single platform for communication and collaboration for mobile workers.

recent_posts.title: Azure Remote Rendering Point Cloud Streaming
recent_posts.summary: Azure Remote Rendering introduces point cloud streaming, which allows for nearly instant visualization of point cloud files with up to 12.5 billion points for a single asset. This new capability enhances mixed reality applications and opens up new possibilities for visualization and real-time interaction on various devices.

recent_posts.title: Customers are driving transformation with mixed reality applications on HoloLens 2
recent_posts.summary: Mixed reality and HoloLens 2 are driving transformation in frontline industries by providing heads-up, hands-free, immersive 3D overlays and visualizations that deliver numerous opportunities to drive value. Global manufacturing enterprises are transforming their operations by deploying Dynamics 365 Remote Assist and Dynamics 365 Guides on HoloLens 2 to accelerate issue resolution, improve training, and enable remote collaboration. Other industries such as energy, healthcare, and consumer goods are also benefiting from mixed reality solutions. Various customer stories demonstrate the positive impact of mixed reality solutions on industries such as oil and gas, lab asset management, power management, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, automotive manufacturing, and chip production. The precision of tasks has been enhanced and operational efficiency has been improved through the use of mixed reality applications. By combining Microsoft mixed reality solutions with third-party platforms, organizations have achieved greater operational efficiency and resource consumption reduction. Microsoft continues to invest in frontline worker enablement and offers a range of technologies, including mixed reality, to transform operations and mitigate disruptions.

recent_posts.title: 3 New Features in Dynamics 365 Guides Version 9.0
recent_posts.summary: Dynamics 365 Guides version 9.0 introduces new features including Object Anchors, packaged guides, and switching environments. Object Anchors allow users to embed holographic content to specific physical objects without the need for QR codes. Packaged guides make it easy to share and maintain guides as point-in-time versions. Switching environments allows users to seamlessly transition between environments on both HoloLens 2 and PC.

recent_posts.title: What’s new in Windows Holographic, version 23H2
recent_posts.summary: Windows Holographic version 23H2 introduces support for NFC readers, faster eye position updates, viewfinder for camera, renaming HoloLens 2 devices, new policies for IT admins, improvements in hand tracking, and font and IME enhancements.

recent_posts.title: Microsoft Mixed Reality Toolkit 3 (MRTK3) moves to an independent organization within GitHub
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft has moved MRTK3 to an independent organization within GitHub, allowing for greater collaboration and expansion. Magic Leap and Qualcomm Technologies have joined the MRTK3 steering committee. MRTK3 is set to reach General Availability in September 2023.

recent_posts.title: Microsoft’s Azure Kinect Developer Kit Technology Transfers to Partner Ecosystem
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft has decided to end production of Azure Kinect Developer Kit but will continue to make the technology available through partners. The company has licensed its pixel and sensor technology to Analog Devices and partnered with Orbbec, among others, to build depth cameras using their iToF technology. Orbbec has launched the Femto Bolt as an alternative to Azure Kinect Developer Kit and provides an SDK wrapper to support more features.

recent_posts.title: Public Preview of Azure Remote Rendering Support for Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest Pro
recent_posts.summary: Azure Remote Rendering now supports Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest Pro virtual reality headsets, allowing developers to render high-quality interactive 3D content and stream it in real time. The service utilizes hybrid rendering, seamlessly combining remote and local content. To get started, users can follow the updated guide for building for Meta Quest.

recent_posts.title: What’s new in Windows Holographic, version 23H1
recent_posts.summary: Windows Holographic version 23H1 is now available, featuring upgrades to Windows 11, increased reliability and predictability for end-users, and easier device management for IT admins. Highlights include manual app updates from the Settings app, the availability of the WebView2 control for embedding web technologies, and requirements for a successful device reset.
